newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong population up to 6.42 million at end-96.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong population up to 6.42 million at end-96.

text.p: The population of Hong Kong was estimated at 6.42 million at the end of 1996, the Census and Statistics Department said on Thursday.
This was up 151,300 persons or 2.4 percent from the end of 1995, it said in a statement.

The balance of births and deaths amounted to 32,800 and accounted for 22 percent of the population growth, the department said. The balance of arrivals and departures showed a net inflow of 118,500 people.
